title: Workspace asset canonical Brand attachment authority

phases.objective: Prevent orphan, cross-tenant, and unauthorized Brand attachment through the existing tenant asset create path while preserving generic workspace-scoped assets and blocking ungoverned Brand reassignment through generic PATCH.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: When brand_ref is supplied it resolves through canonical tenant Brand authority, non-owner actors prove a mutation-capable effective Brand grant, the canonical Brand target key is persisted and read back exactly before commit, and unsafe generic Brand reassignment remains fail-closed.
steps: Resolve supplied brand_ref with the existing canonical workspace Brand resolver inside the resource mutation transaction.
Normalize aliases/display names to the canonical tenant-linked Brand target key before workspace_assets INSERT.
Permit active workspace owner/admin after canonical tenant Brand resolution without requiring a redundant Brand grant.
Require delegated non-owner actors to hold an effective Brand permission in owner/admin/manage/operate/edit before asset persistence.
Reject view/comment/no-grant, cross-tenant, missing, inactive, or ambiguous Brand authority before INSERT.
Read the created asset back under lock inside the same transaction and require persisted brand_ref to equal the canonical resolved Brand key before commit.
Preserve existing workspace-scoped asset creation when brand_ref is absent.
Reject generic PATCH attempts that include brand_ref until a dedicated governed Brand asset rebind lifecycle exists.
Refresh generated resource operation-governance and frontend dispatch evidence for the changed persistence authority source.
assertions: Delegated edit authority persists the canonical Brand target key rather than the caller alias.
Legacy effective Brand owner permission remains mutation-capable for compatibility.
Workspace owner/admin can attach to an active Brand explicitly linked to the same tenant.
View-only and missing Brand grants fail before INSERT.
Cross-tenant Brand references fail before INSERT.
A persisted Brand readback mismatch fails typed before commit so the enclosing transaction can roll back.
Platform-admin resource creation retains its existing system authority boundary while still canonicalizing Brand identity.
Assets without brand_ref remain supported and do not perform unnecessary Brand authority queries.
Generic asset PATCH cannot change brand_ref through an ungoverned path.
No new asset/Brand registry or migration is introduced.
No live SQL Apply, Production/provider mutation, deployment, secret access, force push, or external send occurs in CI.
